steps.en: Install the CLI with the training extra and scaffold a config from a template
steps.zh: 装好带训练 extra 的 CLI，并从模板生成一份配置

steps.en: Fill in the one config — base model, task, data file, LoRA shape
steps.zh: 填好那一份配置——底座模型、任务、数据文件、LoRA 形状

steps.en: Reads the config and fills in the run for you — GPU detection, batch size, quantization
steps.zh: 读这份配置替你定下运行方式——GPU 探测、批大小、量化

steps.en: Streams the frozen base one layer at a time from host RAM instead of holding it in VRAM
steps.zh: 把冻结底座从主机内存一层层流进显存，而不是整块留在显存里

steps.en: Trains and writes a standard PEFT adapter plus its metrics
steps.zh: 训练，并写出标准 PEFT adapter 与对应的指标

steps.en: Talk to the result, or serve it over an OpenAI-compatible API
steps.zh: 和结果对话，或用 OpenAI 兼容接口把它服务起来

steps.en: Merge the adapter into the base, or export it for your runtime
steps.zh: 把 adapter 合并回底座，或按你的运行时导出

value.en: One YAML takes you from a JSONL file to a model you can chat with, serve and export — batch size, quantization and the VRAM workaround are decided for you
value.zh: 一份 YAML 把你从 JSONL 文件带到可对话、可服务、可导出的模型——批大小、量化与显存绕行都由它替你决定

sources: README.md Quick Start (pipx install "soup-cli[train]", soup init --template chat, soup train --config soup.yaml, soup chat --model ./output, soup merge --adapter ./output, soup export --model ./output --format gguf, soup push --model ./output --repo you/my-model)
README.md Configuration (complete soup.yaml: base, task: sft, data.train, data.format, training.batch_size: auto, training.lora.r/alpha, training.quantization: 4bit, output)
README.md top section (layer streaming opt-in stream_layers: true, BETA, 8B NF4 on an RTX 3050 Laptop 4 GB)
README.md Web UI (soup ui serves the local dashboard on http://127.0.0.1:7860)

docs/performance-and-quantization.md Layer Streaming section (training.stream_layers: true, stream_source, stream_buffers, stream_vram_override; 'LoRA adapters + their gradients + optimizer state stay resident in VRAM … the frozen base lives in CPU RAM … each decoder layer is copied into one of two pre-allocated VRAM buffers')
docs/performance-and-quantization.md Multi-GPU section (soup train --config soup.yaml --deepspeed zero2 / --fsdp full_shard)
docs/training.md (task coverage: SFT, DPO/GRPO/PPO/KTO/ORPO/SimPO/IPO/BCO, PRM, pre-training, distillation, classification, vision/audio/TTS, unlearning, RAFT/RA-DIT)
examples/configs/sft_basic.yaml, examples/configs/dpo_chat.yaml, examples/data/alpaca_tiny.jsonl (worked config + data examples)
